description: A hand-picked collection of the finest of resources for the most awesome of agents, Claude Code, the undisputed champion of coding companions, from the unstoppable team at Anthropic PBC (no affiliation). A delectable showcase of top tier skills, ambidextrous agents, scintillating status lines, top notch developer tooling, and also we have plugins

summary.one_liner: A curated, categorized list of resources, tools, plugins, skills, guides and status lines for Claude Code, Anthropic's coding agent.
summary.what_it_does: This is an "awesome" list: a hand-picked Markdown index of third-party and Anthropic-published resources for Claude Code, each with a one-line annotated description. The README (as captured here, truncated) is organized into sections such as Start Here, From Anthropic, Documentation & Learning, Obsidian, Open Source Contribution, Research, Providers & Integration, Remote Control & Notifications, Alternative Clients, Status Lines, Design & UI/UX, and more, with a Table of Contents covering further categories like Security, Agent Orchestration, Memory, Observability, Testing and Linting. Entries link to external projects, guides, and skills, and the descriptions often note security posture, testing, or maintenance status. The README also explains that a newer curated format replaces an earlier list, with older entries preserved in a README_ALTERNATIVES directory. The list does not itself provide installable software.
use_cases: Finding Claude Code skills, plugins, and hooks
Discovering status line tools for Claude Code
Learning Claude Code through guides and tutorials
Browsing remote control and notification tools for agent sessions
Finding Obsidian and knowledge-base integrations for Claude Code
Looking up alternative desktop or web clients for Claude Code
notable: Curated, annotated entries with opinionated commentary on quality and security
Covers beginner guides as well as skills, plugins, status lines, and alternative clients
Sections for Obsidian integration, research workflows, and remote/voice control
Includes a list of Anthropic's own official resources alongside community projects
caveats: Entries are third-party projects; the list does not vouch for their ongoing maintenance or security
The README as provided is truncated, so many categories and entries are not visible
Some entries are marked as legacy and preserved without updates in a separate directory
